The zero-score penalty for a negative balance at matchday start is therefore not in play — and the single most important thing to preserve in the final ninety minutes is exactly that.

He is fit but is not a Mainz starter — two appearances, no starts, about five percent of the available minutes — so one of the eleven slots is effectively dead for this matchday. The arithmetic has now been run at every price point on the board and there is no affordable fix before the lock. verdict.headline: No action.
verdict.detail: No action. The squad is exactly eleven, all eleven are placed in the only legal formation (4-4-2), the balance is positive, and nobody is hurt. The board cannot help: with the lock under two hours away, only one listing on the entire market expires in time to be bought at all, and he is a substitute who scores less than the man he would replace. Field the eleven and leave the balance alone.

sell.reason: Nothing to sell. The squad is at the eleven-player minimum, so any sale drops the side below a fillable formation and triggers the -100 under-eleven penalty, and no replacement can land in time to prevent it. The weakest holding is Nakuzola, but selling him without a replacement is strictly worse than fielding him. This is a deliberate hold, not an oversight.

buy.reason: Nothing to buy, and the reason is mechanical rather than a matter of taste. A Kickbase board listing resolves only when its own auction clock expires, so to help this matchday a listing must expire before the lock. Exactly one of the twenty board listings does. That is Seol, and he fails on merit: an Augsburg substitute who has played under a fifth of the available minutes, with a season average below the defender he would displace, at home to Bayern — and his price exceeds the cash balance, so buying him would force an unwind sale inside the final ninety minutes for a swap that loses points. Everything else on the board expires after the lock. The manager asks are all well above market value, which this ledger has never paid. Nandja, the one listing added since the last run, is dead on both counts: he expires after kickoff and is negative on the season.

Only four qualify: Guirassy 32.948.666 (ap 161), Nusa 28.261.137 (ap 169), Engelhardt 14.880.633 (ap 149), Neuer 13.077.867 (ap 143) — all four CONFIRMED starters on the 09.10.2026 source, every one a huge points downgrade to Ryerson. Note the shape for reuse: a buy that passes the two-clock test can still die on the unwind, and with cash at 1.344.720 the unwind ceiling for a single-buy-single-sale is the mv of the cheapest starter he would actually part with.

(2) FLORIAN MÜLLER (1910, GK, Freiburg tid 5), the only listing new since the 12:45Z run (hit the board 12:50:22Z). Board listing, prc 500.000 = mv, mvt 0 (no drift, so no flip edge either). exs 49.700 -> resolves ~2026-10-10T04:33Z, AFTER the 18:30Z lock. Dies on the two-clock test for MD5. On merit he is also nothing: a 500.000 backup keeper behind Neuer (ap 143), and 4-4-2 fields exactly one GK.

(3) SALIM MUSAH (11262, ATT, Bremen tid 10). Board, prc 500.000 = mv, mvt 0, exs 3.656 -> resolves ~15:46Z, pre-lock, so timing is not the kill. Merit is: st 1 (not fit), ap 9, p 26. 4-4-2 fields exactly two ATT and both are confirmed starters, Guirassy ap 161 and Gregoritsch ap 137, so he is a 12th body worth zero MD5 points. PRE-LOCK RESOLUTION CENSUS, so no later run recomputes it: of 22 board listings only FOUR have exs below 13.500 and can therefore resolve before the lock — Ryerson 1.323, Bachmann 2.657 (dead, Azc5fgn), Musah 3.656 (dead here), Seol 11.765 (dead, Axouqcv). killed_this_run.name: Marco Grüll — the two-leg upgrade route
killed_this_run.why: SHARPENS W9fc4jb (closed) RATHER THAN REVERSING IT, AND IS LOGGED IN FULL SO NO LATER RUN RE-DERIVES IT. W9fc4jb claimed "no buy can help MD5 at all". Re-enumerated fresh this run, that claim is TOO STRONG as stated: there is EXACTLY ONE arithmetically legal, timing-feasible buy that improves the fielded XI, and it is Grüll. State it once so it is never mistaken for an unexplored option. THE ROUTE: Grüll (7721, MID Werder tid 10) is a MANAGER ask by Daggi D. at 15.500.000 vs mv 13.502.741 (+14,79%), listed 2026-10-06T19:10:52Z and unsold for 2,5 days. Manager asks are the ONLY buys that can settle before the 18:30Z lock — ALL 20 board listings have exs running past it (shortest is Köhn exs 11.466 = 09.10 09:56Z... still pre-lock, but board listings are auctions that only resolve AT expiry, and the rest run to 19:08Z and beyond). Buy first (spending power 35.471.903 covers 15.500.000), then sell Treu 13.112.760 + Engelhardt 14.880.633 = 27.993.393, landing cash at +465.353 and squad at 11 = 1 GK / 4 DEF (ter Horst, Gruber, Deman, Nakuzola) / 4 MID (Nusa, Wolf, Tanaka, Grüll) / 2 ATT = a legal 4-4-2. XI ap goes 1353 - 76 (Treu) - 149 (Engelhardt) + 27 (Nakuzola) + 185 (Grüll) = 1340, against the Treu-only baseline of 1304. THE ROUTE IS WORTH +36 ap AND IT IS STILL A NO. Three reasons, all independent. (1) THE TAIL IS THE WHOLE MATCHDAY. A manager ask is not instant — Daggi D. must accept. If he accepts at 18:25Z there is no time to execute two sell-backs, cash sits at -27.528.040 at the lock, and the ENTIRE MD5 scores ZERO. Risking ~1300 points to win 36 is a catastrophic-tail trade and the 33%-floor/negative-balance mechanic outranks every points consideration. (2) CAPITAL. +14,79% over mv is 1.997.259 of premium against a MEASURED manager-ask clearing band of +3,06% to +4,35% — the ask is unsold precisely because it is far out of band — plus a realised 619.367 loss on Engelhardt, who was bought at 15.500.000 two days ago and is the squad's strongest riser (sdmvt +1.001.020). ~2,6m of value destroyed for one matchday of +36. (3) IT CHURNS THE LEDGER'S OWN BEST BUY. Engelhardt was logged as "the first genuine POINTS buy this ledger has cleared in weeks"; selling him at mv to chase a similar premium elsewhere is exactly the behaviour the calibration table exists to prevent. FITNESS IS NOT THE OBJECTION AND WAS CHECKED PROPERLY: Grüll is st 0, ap 185 (highest in the market), p 739 over 4 matchdays, absent from Ligainsider's Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table read 09.10.2026, and named in the predicted Werder XI v Dortmund in a tips.gg piece dated 07.10.2026 08:21. He is a genuine starter and a legitimate MD6 target — do NOT lose him. REVERSAL FOR MD6: once the balance is non-negative and the lock is far out, this route collapses to a simple one-for-one upgrade with no tail, and should be re-tested on the premium alone.

Both expiries fall AFTER the MD5 lock at 2026-10-09T18:30:00Z, so neither can enter the MD5 eleven whatever he is worth; and a win would land cash at roughly -12,5m against a post-sale balance of 1.084.720, i.e. it would re-open exactly the leveraged position this run exists to close. killed_this_run.why:

THE ROUTE, WHICH IS REAL AND REFINES Axouqcv. Axouqcv settled that after the Treu sale the squad is 1 GK / 4 DEF / 4 MID / 2 ATT = 11 and "the ONLY fillable formation is 4-4-2 exactly, with Nakuzola (ap 27) forced into the back four". That is true ONLY FOR A DEF TWELFTH BODY, which is all Axouqcv tested (Koehn, Seol, Huebers). A CHEAP ATT TWELFTH BODY IS DIFFERENT: it makes the squad 1/4/4/3 and opens 3-4-3, which drops Nakuzola OUT of the eleven instead of forcing him in. So the dead DEF slot has an escape hatch, and it costs only the price of the body. The affordability is also clean: Treu 13.112.760 against cash -12.028.040 leaves 1.084.720, Boniface at 994.284 leaves +90.436, non-negative at the lock, squad 12, no second sale needed and nothing to unwind. On ap alone it reads +16 (43 in for 27 out).

WHY IT STILL DIES, AND IT DIES ON THE PLAYER, NOT ON THE MECHANICS. The ap 43 is the cameo trap this ledger is warned about, and the dated sources say so outright. Ligainsider's player page (read 08.10.2026) gives his 26/27 Bundesliga record as NO STARTS, 12 MINUTES as a substitute and 369 MINUTES ON THE BENCH; his newest item is 05.09.2026 "Boniface noch nicht bereit fuer Dreifachbelastung". p 43 over ap 43 is one scored matchday off twelve minutes of football — a high average off cameo minutes, which is exactly the inverse trap, and the mv of 994.284 for a contracted Leverkusen striker is the market pricing the bench, not a bargain. He is FIT (not on Ligainsider's Verletzte-und-Gesperrte table read 08.10.2026, Kickbase st 0), so this is a SELECTION kill, not a fitness kill. An expected zero does not beat Nakuzola's 27, and mvt 2 means he is not a flip either.

FOR THE NEXT RUN: the 3-4-3 hatch stays open. Re-test it against any cheap ATT on the board at or below the post-Treu cushion with a DATED starting-XI source. The test is not ap — it is minutes. Do not re-derive the formation arithmetic.

killed_this_run.name: Janik Bachmann — THE BODY CASE IS NOW DEAD TOO. This REVERSES BUY B3fyppp (closed), which is hereby withdrawn.
killed_this_run.why: EXPLICIT REVERSAL, SAID OUT LOUD. BUY B3fyppp bought Bachmann (3307, MID Schalke tid 8, mv 500.000, mvt 0) purely as a BODY — bench insurance against the -100 under-eleven penalty after the Treu sale leaves exactly eleven players and eleven placed. Its own stated premise was that it was being written "with MD5 team news still to come". THAT PREMISE IS NOW RESOLVED, AND RESOLVED FAVOURABLY. bundesliga.com's MD5 preview dated 08.10.2026 confirms ALL ELEVEN retained players fit and in their clubs' probable XIs (Neuer, ter Horst, Gruber, Deman, Engelhardt, Tanaka, Wolf, Gregoritsch, Nusa, Guirassy — plus Nakuzola, who is in the squad but not in Mainz's XI, which is a points problem and not a squad-count problem), and every squad row carries st 0. The -100 triggers on SQUAD COUNT below eleven at matchday start, not on a player being benched, injured or scoring zero — a non-playing player still occupies his slot and simply returns 0. With the transfer window shut and no further sale planned, nothing can take the squad below eleven except Georg himself. The insured event is therefore close to impossible, and 500.000 is an expensive premium against it. THE POSITIVE CASE FOR HOLDING THE CASH INSTEAD, WHICH IS THE REAL REASON FOR THE REVERSAL: post-sale cash is exactly 1.031.188, and per WATCH Wqf04d5 the post-sale XI carries a DEAD DEF SLOT because Nakuzola is not in Mainz's eleven. Bachmann is a MID and cannot fill that slot — he would add a fifth midfielder to a squad whose only legal formation after the sale is 4-4-2, so he contributes exactly zero points. Spending 500.000 of a 1.031.188 cushion on him would halve the only money available to buy a cheap STARTING DEF if one lists on the board below the cushion before the 2026-10-09T18:30Z lock. That option is worth more than a premium against a near-impossible event. ALSO NOTE A2wqgij REMAINS OPEN AND CORRECT on its own separate ground (mvt 0, measured drift +0,02%, so he is worthless as a tick flip). Both routes to Bachmann are now closed. DO NOT REVERSE THIS back into a buy merely because the squad is at eleven — an empty bench is not an exposure. Reverse ONLY if a squad player is actually REMOVED from Kickbase (not merely benched or injured) before the lock, taking the count to ten.

Tick: mvt 2, so tonight's 20:00Z update is expected to take ~3,2% OFF him before he could ever be resold. He would be the right player at the right position if the envelope existed — record that, because if a funding leg ever appears while he is still listed he is a genuine candidate, but he must then be re-verified on a source dated at that time.

movers.reason: Flip window closed — the matchday locks in under two hours, and a flip left open at the lock risks the whole matchday. Worth noting that the edge itself is intact rather than decaying: re-measured from the event log this run, rising-flag players gained an average of 2,75% at the next daily update and rose 89,9% of the time, which is marginally stronger than the long-running baseline. Two questions remain unresolved and should stay on the record: whether Kickbase caps squad size, which would cap how many flips can run at once, and the fact that this edge is measured in one league over one period and will decay if rivals crowd into it.

fitness.sweep: Clean sweep, and fresher than any previous run this cycle. All eleven squad players carry a zero status flag, and a direct fetch of Ligainsider's injured-and-suspended table returns no entry for any of them. No squad player is newly injured, suspended, benched, or carrying dated news of a move out of the league.
